title: त्रयोदशोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 13 · The far islands, Rahu and the moon

summary.en: Sanjaya describes the northern islands with their seas of ghee, curds and wine. He ends the survey of the earth with the sun, moon and Rahu and returns to Bharata, where the war is to be fought.
summary.kn: ತುಪ್ಪ, ಮೊಸರು, ಸುರೆಗಳ ಸಮುದ್ರಗಳಿರುವ ಉತ್ತರ ದ್ವೀಪಗಳನ್ನು ಸಂಜಯ ವರ್ಣಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಸೂರ್ಯ, ಚಂದ್ರ, ರಾಹುಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಭೂಸಮೀಕ್ಷೆಯನ್ನು ಮುಗಿಸಿ ಯುದ್ಧ ನಡೆಯುವ ಭಾರತಕ್ಕೆ ಮರಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: संजय घी, दही और सुरा के समुद्रों वाले उत्तरी द्वीपों का वर्णन करते हैं। सूर्य, चन्द्र और राहु के साथ भू-वर्णन समाप्त कर वे उस भारत पर लौटते हैं जहाँ युद्ध होना है।
summary.te: నెయ్యి, పెరుగు, సురా సముద్రాలున్న ఉత్తర ద్వీపాలను సంజయుడు వర్ణిస్తాడు. సూర్య, చంద్ర, రాహువులతో భూవర్ణన ముగించి యుద్ధం జరగబోయే భారతానికి తిరిగి వస్తాడు.
summary.ta: நெய், தயிர், மதுக் கடல்கள் உள்ள வடக்குத் தீவுகளைச் சஞ்சயன் விவரிக்கிறான். சூரியன், சந்திரன், ராகு பற்றிக் கூறி நிலவிளக்கத்தை முடித்து, போர் நடக்கவிருக்கும் பாரதத்துக்குத் திரும்புகிறான்.
summary.ml: നെയ്യിന്റെയും തൈരിന്റെയും വീഞ്ഞിന്റെയും സമുദ്രങ്ങളുള്ള വടക്കൻ ദ്വീപുകളെ സഞ്ജയൻ വിവരിക്കുന്നു. സൂര്യനെയും ചന്ദ്രനെയും രാഹുവിനെയും കുറിച്ച് പറഞ്ഞ് ഭൂമിയുടെ വിവരണം അവസാനിപ്പിക്കുന്നു; യുദ്ധം നടക്കാനിരിക്കുന്ന ഭാരതത്തിലേക്ക് അദ്ദേഹം മടങ്ങുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 6.13; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Jul 26 2021

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
उत्तरेषु तु कौरव्य द्वीपेषु श्रूयते कथा ।
यथाश्रुतं महाराज ब्रुवतस्तन्निबोध मे ॥

meaning.en: Descendant of Kuru, a tale is told of the northern islands; hear from me, great king, what I have heard as I tell it.

verses.text:
घृततोयः समुद्रोऽत्र दधिमण्डोदकोऽपरः ।
सुरोदः सागरश्चैव तथान्यो घर्मसागरः ॥

meaning.en: There is a sea of ghee-water here, another with water like curd-whey, a sea of wine, and another, a sea of sweat.

verses.text:
परस्परेण द्विगुणाः सर्वे द्वीपा नराधिप ।
सर्वतश्च महाराज पर्वतैः परिवारिताः ॥

meaning.en: Lord of men, each island is twice the size of the one before, and, great king, all are surrounded on every side by mountains.

verses.text:
गौरस्तु मध्यमे द्वीपे गिरिर्मानःशिलो महान् ।
पर्वतः पश्चिमः कृष्णो नारायणनिभो नृप ॥

meaning.en: In the middle island is the fair great mountain Manahshila; the western mountain is dark, like Narayana, King.

verses.text:
तत्र रत्नानि दिव्यानि स्वयं रक्षति केशवः ।
प्रजापतिमुपासीनः प्रजानां विदधे सुखम् ॥

meaning.en: There Keshava himself guards the divine jewels; seated in worship of Prajapati, he brings happiness to the people.

verses.text:
कुशद्वीपे कुशस्तम्बो मध्ये जनपदस्य ह ।
संपूज्यते शल्मलिश्च द्वीपे शाल्मलिके नृप ॥

meaning.en: In Kushadvipa a clump of kusha grass is worshipped in the middle of the country, and in the island Shalmalika, King, the shalmali tree.

verses.text:
क्रौञ्चद्वीपे महाक्रौञ्चो गिरी रत्नचयाकरः ।
संपूज्यते महाराज चातुर्वर्ण्येन नित्यदा ॥

meaning.en: In Kraunchadvipa the great mountain Mahakraunch is a mine of heaps of gems, and, great king, it is always worshipped by people of the four classes.

verses.text:
गोमन्दः पर्वतो राजन्सुमहान्सर्वधातुमान् ।
यत्र नित्यं निवसति श्रीमान्कमललोचनः ।
मोक्षिभिः संस्तुतो नित्यं प्रभुर्नारायणो हरिः ॥

meaning.en: King, the very great mountain Gomanda has every mineral; there the glorious lotus-eyed Lord Narayana Hari always dwells, ever praised by those seeking liberation.

verses.text:
कुशद्वीपे तु राजेन्द्र पर्वतो विद्रुमैश्चितः ।
सुधामा नाम दुर्धर्षो द्वितीयो हेमपर्वतः ॥

meaning.en: In Kushadvipa, king of kings, one mountain is covered with coral, called Sudhama, unassailable; the second is the golden mountain.

verses.text:
द्युतिमान्नाम कौरव्य तृतीयः कुमुदो गिरिः ।
चतुर्थः पुष्पवान्नाम पञ्चमस्तु कुशेशयः ॥

meaning.en: Descendant of Kuru, the third mountain is Dyutiman, the fourth Kumuda, the fifth Pushpavan, and the sixth Kushesaya.

verses.text:
षष्ठो हरिगिरिर्नाम षडेते पर्वतोत्तमाः ।
तेषामन्तरविष्कम्भो द्विगुणः प्रविभागशः ॥

meaning.en: The sixth is Harigiri; these are six excellent mountains; the width between them doubles in each division.

verses.text:
औद्भिदं प्रथमं वर्षं द्वितीयं वेणुमण्डलम् ।
तृतीयं वै रथाकारं चतुर्थं पालनं स्मृतम् ॥

meaning.en: The first region is called Audbhida, the second Venumandala, the third Rathakara, and the fourth is remembered as Palana.

verses.text:
धृतिमत्पञ्चमं वर्षं षष्ठं वर्षं प्रभाकरम् ।
सप्तमं कापिलं वर्षं सप्तैते वर्षपुञ्जकाः ॥

meaning.en: The fifth region is Dhritimat, the sixth Prabhakara, the seventh Kapila; these are the seven clusters of regions.

verses.text:
एतेषु देवगन्धर्वाः प्रजाश्च जगतीश्वर ।
विहरन्ति रमन्ते च न तेषु म्रियते जनः ॥

meaning.en: In these, lord of the earth, gods, Gandharvas and the people roam and delight, and no one dies in them.

verses.text:
न तेषु दस्यवः सन्ति म्लेच्छजात्योऽपि वा नृप ।
गौरप्रायो जनः सर्वः सुकुमारश्च पार्थिव ॥

meaning.en: There are no robbers there, King, nor Mleccha tribes; all the people are mostly fair and delicate.

verses.text:
अवशिष्टेषु वर्षेषु वक्ष्यामि मनुजेश्वर ।
यथाश्रुतं महाराज तदव्यग्रमनाः शृणु ॥

meaning.en: I will now tell you of the remaining regions, lord of men, as I have heard them; listen with an undistracted mind, great king.

verses.text:
क्रौञ्चद्वीपे महाराज क्रौञ्चो नाम महागिरिः ।
क्रौञ्चात्परो वामनको वामनादन्धकारकः ॥

meaning.en: In Kraunchadvipa, great king, is the great mountain called Krauncha; beyond Krauncha is Vamanaka, beyond Vamanaka Andhakaraka.

verses.text:
अन्धकारात्परो राजन्मैनाकः पर्वतोत्तमः ।
मैनाकात्परतो राजन्गोविन्दो गिरिरुत्तमः ॥

meaning.en: Beyond Andhakara, King, is the best of mountains, Mainaka; beyond Mainaka is the excellent mountain Govinda.

verses.text:
गोविन्दात्तु परो राजन्निबिडो नाम पर्वतः ।
परस्तु द्विगुणस्तेषां विष्कम्भो वंशवर्धन ॥

meaning.en: Beyond Govinda, King, is the mountain Nibida; the width of the farther ones is double, you who extend your line.

verses.text:
देशांस्तत्र प्रवक्ष्यामि तन्मे निगदतः शृणु ।
क्रौञ्चस्य कुशलो देशो वामनस्य मनोनुगः ॥

meaning.en: I will describe the countries there; listen as I tell it. The country of Krauncha is Kushala, and that of Vamana is Manonuga.

verses.text:
मनोनुगात्परश्चोष्णो देशः कुरुकुलोद्वह ।
उष्णात्परः प्रावरकः प्रावरादन्धकारकः ॥

meaning.en: Beyond Manonuga, bearer of the Kuru line, is the country Ushna; beyond Ushna is Pravaraka, and beyond Pravara, Andhakaraka.

verses.text:
अन्धकारकदेशात्तु मुनिदेशः परः स्मृतः ।
मुनिदेशात्परश्चैव प्रोच्यते दुन्दुभिस्वनः ॥

meaning.en: Beyond the country of Andhakaraka is called the land of the sages, and beyond the land of the sages is said to be Dundubhisvana.

verses.text:
सिद्धचारणसंकीर्णो गौरप्रायो जनाधिप ।
एते देशा महाराज देवगन्धर्वसेविताः ॥

meaning.en: It is crowded with Siddhas and Charanas, lord of the people, and its people are mostly fair; these countries, great king, are frequented by gods and Gandharvas.

verses.text:
पुष्करे पुष्करो नाम पर्वतो मणिरत्नमान् ।
तत्र नित्यं निवसति स्वयं देवः प्रजापतिः ॥

meaning.en: In Pushkara the mountain Pushkara has gems and jewels, and there the god Prajapati himself always dwells.

verses.text:
तं पर्युपासते नित्यं देवाः सर्वे महर्षिभिः ।
वाग्भिर्मनोनुकूलाभिः पूजयन्तो जनाधिप ॥

meaning.en: All the gods with great sages always attend him, lord of the people, honouring him with words that please his mind.

verses.text:
जम्बूद्वीपात्प्रवर्तन्ते रत्नानि विविधान्युत ।
द्वीपेषु तेषु सर्वेषु प्रजानां कुरुनन्दन ॥

meaning.en: Jewels of many kinds come from Jambudvipa, descendant of Kuru, for the people in all those islands.

verses.text:
विप्राणां ब्रह्मचर्येण सत्येन च दमेन च ।
आरोग्यायुःप्रमाणाभ्यां द्विगुणं द्विगुणं ततः ॥

meaning.en: Through the Brahmins' celibacy, truth and self-control, in health and length of life, each is twice the one before.

verses.text:
एको जनपदो राजन्द्वीपेष्वेतेषु भारत ।
उक्ता जनपदा येषु धर्मश्चैकः प्रदृश्यते ॥

meaning.en: King, in these islands there is one country, Bharata; in the countries named, one single dharma is seen.

verses.text:
ईश्वरो दण्डमुद्यम्य स्वयमेव प्रजापतिः ।
द्वीपानेतान्महाराज रक्षंस्तिष्ठति नित्यदा ॥

meaning.en: The Lord Prajapati himself, raising the rod of punishment, always stands guarding these islands, great king.

verses.text:
स राजा स शिवो राजन्स पिता स पितामहः ।
गोपायति नरश्रेष्ठ प्रजाः सजडपण्डिताः ॥

meaning.en: He is the king, he is Shiva, he is father and grandfather; best of men, he protects the people, both dull and learned.

verses.text:
भोजनं चात्र कौरव्य प्रजाः स्वयमुपस्थितम् ।
सिद्धमेव महाराज भुञ्जते तत्र नित्यदा ॥

meaning.en: Descendant of Kuru, there the people find their food ready by itself, and great king, they eat food already prepared, always.

verses.text:
ततः परं समा नाम दृश्यते लोकसंस्थितिः ।
चतुरश्रा महाराज त्रयस्त्रिंशत्तु मण्डलम् ॥

meaning.en: Beyond that is seen a world-structure called Sama, square, great king, with a circle of thirty-three.

verses.text:
तत्र तिष्ठन्ति कौरव्य चत्वारो लोकसंमताः ।
दिग्गजा भरतश्रेष्ठ वामनैरावतादयः ।
सुप्रतीकस्तथा राजन्प्रभिन्नकरटामुखः ॥

meaning.en: There, descendant of Kuru, stand four world-honoured elephants of the quarters, best of the Bharatas, Vamana, Airavata and the others, and Supratika, King, with the rut-streaming face.

verses.text:
तस्याहं परिमाणं तु न संख्यातुमिहोत्सहे ।
असंख्यातः स नित्यं हि तिर्यगूर्ध्वमधस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: I cannot undertake to count its measure here, for it is always immeasurable, across, above and below.

verses.text:
तत्र वै वायवो वान्ति दिग्भ्यः सर्वाभ्य एव च ।
असंबाधा महाराज तान्निगृह्णन्ति ते गजाः ॥

meaning.en: There winds blow from all directions; unobstructed, great king, they are held back by those elephants.

verses.text:
पुष्करैः पद्मसंकाशैर्वर्ष्मवद्भिर्महाप्रभैः ।
ते शनैः पुनरेवाशु वायून्मुञ्चन्ति नित्यशः ॥

meaning.en: With their trunks, shining like lotuses and mighty and splendid, they slowly and again quickly release the winds, always.

verses.text:
श्वसद्भिर्मुच्यमानास्तु दिग्गजैरिह मारुताः ।
आगच्छन्ति महाराज ततस्तिष्ठन्ति वै प्रजाः ॥

meaning.en: The winds released by the breathing elephants of the quarters come here, great king, and then the people live.

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
परो वै विस्तरोऽत्यर्थं त्वया संजय कीर्तितः ।
दर्शितं द्वीपसंस्थानमुत्तरं ब्रूहि संजय ॥

meaning.en: Sanjaya, you have told me a vast and extreme detail; you have shown the layout of the islands. Now tell me of what lies beyond.

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
उक्ता द्वीपा महाराज ग्रहान्मे शृणु तत्त्वतः ।
स्वर्भानुः कौरवश्रेष्ठ यावदेष प्रभावतः ॥

meaning.en: Great king, I have told of the islands; now hear truly of the planets. Svarbhanu, best of the Kauravas, as far as his power extends.

verses.text:
परिमण्डलो महाराज स्वर्भानुः श्रूयते ग्रहः ।
योजनानां सहस्राणि विष्कम्भो द्वादशास्य वै ॥

meaning.en: Great king, the planet Svarbhanu is heard to be round, with a width of twelve thousand yojanas.

verses.text:
परिणाहेन षट्त्रिंशद्विपुलत्वेन चानघ ।
षष्टिमाहुः शतान्यस्य बुधाः पौराणिकास्तथा ॥

meaning.en: Sinless one, the ancient sages say that his circumference is thirty-six and his thickness sixty hundred.

verses.text:
चन्द्रमास्तु सहस्राणि राजन्नेकादश स्मृतः ।
विष्कम्भेण कुरुश्रेष्ठ त्रयस्त्रिंशत्तु मण्डलम् ।
एकोनषष्टिर्वैपुल्याच्छीतरश्मेर्महात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: King, the moon is said to be eleven thousand in width, best of the Kurus, with a circle of thirty-three and a thickness of fifty-nine of the cool-rayed great-souled one.

verses.text:
सूर्यस्त्वष्टौ सहस्राणि द्वे चान्ये कुरुनन्दन ।
विष्कम्भेण ततो राजन्मण्डलं त्रिंशतं समम् ॥

meaning.en: Descendant of Kuru, the sun is eight thousand and two thousand more in width, King, and its circle is an even thirty.

verses.text:
अष्टपञ्चाशतं राजन्विपुलत्वेन चानघ ।
श्रूयते परमोदारः पतंगोऽसौ विभावसुः ।
एतत्प्रमाणमर्कस्य निर्दिष्टमिह भारत ॥

meaning.en: King, sinless one, its thickness is fifty-eight; the sun, supremely generous, bird of the sky, Vibhavasu, is heard of so; thus the measure of the sun is stated here, Bharata.

verses.text:
स राहुश्छादयत्येतौ यथाकालं महत्तया ।
चन्द्रादित्यौ महाराज संक्षेपोऽयमुदाहृतः ॥

meaning.en: In due season, by his greatness, that Rahu covers these two, the moon and the sun, great king; this is the summary.

verses.text:
इत्येतत्ते महाराज पृच्छतः शास्त्रचक्षुषा ।
सर्वमुक्तं यथातत्त्वं तस्माच्छममवाप्नुहि ॥

meaning.en: Great king, I have told you all as it truly is, as you asked, with the eye of scripture; therefore find peace.

verses.text:
यथादृष्टं मया प्रोक्तं सनिर्याणमिदं जगत् ।
तस्मादाश्वस कौरव्य पुत्रं दुर्योधनं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: I have told you what I have seen, of this world with its departure; so be reassured, descendant of Kuru, about your son Duryodhana.

verses.text:
श्रुत्वेदं भरतश्रेष्ठ भूमिपर्व मनोनुगम् ।
श्रीमान्भवति राजन्यः सिद्धार्थः साधुसंमतः ।
आयुर्बलं च वीर्यं च तस्य तेजश्च वर्धते ॥

meaning.en: Best of the Bharatas, a king who hears this Bhumi Parva, agreeable to the mind, becomes prosperous, fulfilled and honoured by the good; his life, strength, vigour and splendour increase.

verses.text:
यः शृणोति महीपाल पर्वणीदं यतव्रतः ।
प्रीयन्ते पितरस्तस्य तथैव च पितामहाः ॥

meaning.en: Lord of the earth, the one who listens to this at the festival days, firm in his vows, delights his forefathers and grandfathers.

verses.text:
इदं तु भारतं वर्षं यत्र वर्तामहे वयम् ।
पूर्वं प्रवर्तते पुण्यं तत्सर्वं श्रुतवानसि ॥

meaning.en: You have heard all about this land of Bharata, where we live, and its holy past that goes on.
